settings.question: How is this different from my regular electric toothbrush?
settings.answer: Auvelle uses true sonic vibration — 31,000 strokes per minute versus the 8,000–10,000 found in most rotating brushes. This fluid dynamic cleans between teeth and below the gumline, reaching where bristles can't.

settings.question: How long before I see whitening results?
settings.answer: Most customers notice a difference within 7–10 days using the Whitening mode daily. Full results — up to 5 shades whiter — typically develop over 14–30 days depending on existing stains.

settings.question: Is it safe for sensitive teeth and gums?
settings.answer: Yes. The Sensitive mode reduces vibration intensity by 40% while maintaining effective cleaning. The built-in pressure sensor prevents over-brushing — the leading cause of enamel erosion.

settings.question: How long does the battery last?
settings.answer: Up to 30 days on a single 2-hour USB-C charge (based on 2 minutes twice daily). A low-battery LED gives advance notice before it needs charging.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a no-questions-asked 90-day money-back guarantee. Contact our team and we'll arrange a full refund — no need to return the brush.

settings.question: How often should I replace the brush head?
settings.answer: Every 3 months — the same as a manual toothbrush. The blue indicator bristles fade to white to let you know when it's time to replace.
